limitations: Automatic anatomy classification/projection can be ambiguous. Unmatched sources keep an explicit reason and need manual classification or placement.
383 of the final desktop workflow's 478 pieces require distortion review; physical material trials remain necessary. Test acknowledgement is isolated from user projects.
The 500-piece and 200 MiB archive limits remain enforced. The simple fewer-seams preset is 120 degrees /2000 faces.
Bounded point normalization plus numerical retrace removal is checked for material area and topology, not a global Hausdorff bound for zero-area needle tips.
Existing locked/manual project results are not silently recomputed; applying new extraction requires an explicit undoable re-split.
Application remains an internal development preview; Rust format/lint gates were blocked by the environment and Git commit/merge could not be performed.
